negative_reviews.author: Martina Crepaldi
negative_reviews.text: Booked here for my birthday because the food and the reviews seemed spectacular! Sadly I never made to ordering some food. Even if we booked weeks in advance the not-bother-to-be-here server made us seat in the downstairs bit, that was empty, smelled like toilet and had used never collected blue roll under our not clean table. There were also a selection of cleaning products on the closed bar top. The said server handled us some menus like he was doing us a favour and while going away from the table he murmured “oh, happy birthday by the way”. I was honestly left without words by the unwelcoming and smelly atmosphere. We gave it 3 seconds to decide, while all we could smell was toilet and decided to head somewhere else. That left us with no plans for a birthday in a very busy city. Not a place I can ever suggest, you can not have good food and terrible service with the prices as they are nowadays- but again I was left just wondering about the quality of food that I’ll never try.
